第23章 生财之道被断了（第1页）
“哦……”言安希点点头，那正好，不然她要和他在一张桌子上吃饭，她还不知道要怎么办。
昨天晚上他甩门走了，也不知道他今天气消了没有。
管家和气的说道：“今天太太穿的这条裙子很合身，看来店员的尺寸估算还是很准的。太太，什么时候你方便的话，让人来给您量一下准确尺寸。”
言安希眼睛转了转，这是要给她私人定制衣服？那好啊，她不嫌多的，对她来说，多一件……那都是钱啊。
她故作矜持的点了点头，心里却乐开了花。
管家又接着说道：“太太的衣服都是定制版，慕城仅此一件，还是按照您的标准尺寸来比较好……”
“什么？”管家话还没说完，言安希已经惊叫出声，“只有一件？比限量版还限量版？”
“是，品牌为您独家量身定制。您看今天的这条裙子，就很合您的气质。”
言安希的心一下子就从天堂跌落谷底了，只有一件的衣服，她要怎么转手卖？
这好好的一条生财之道，就这么的断了。
言安希根本掩饰不住自己的失落，敷衍似的朝管家点点头，然后自顾自的吃着早餐了。
可恨啊可恨，慕迟曜是不是故意的？他是不是早就想到，她可能会把值钱的东西给转手卖掉，所以早就堵住了她的退路？
言安希吃完早餐，夏初初正好给她发来短信：九点半，我们在苑华公司门口见。
她站了起来，拿起自己的包包背上，管家问道：“太太，您要出门？”
“好的，太太请稍等，我去给您安排车。”
“不用不用，”言安希连忙摆手，“我自己去就好了，不用麻烦了。”
她是去找工作啊，又不是去视察，慕迟曜的车随随便便开一辆出来，都价值不菲。她要是坐着豪车去应聘，哪家公司敢雇用她？
在言安希的坚持下，管家也只好妥协了。
言安希从别墅里走出来，快步的往外走去。
现在是早上，阳光明媚，她也才真正看清了这年华别墅，到底有多奢华。
昨天晚上她只是匆匆的扫了一眼，现在仔细看，再一次被震撼。
言安希一边感叹一边左顾右盼，走到雕花大铁门处的时候，看见外面停着一辆白色的敞篷跑车，里面坐着一个戴着墨镜的女子，红唇十分妖艳。
她也不认识，所以就没在意，从旁边的小门里走了出去，这才算是真正意义上的走出了年华别墅。
言安希站在年华别墅的大门口，思考着该从哪边走去地铁站或者公交车站，她是个路痴，方向感一直都很差。
她正想着拿手机出来查一下地图，忽然听见一个十分趾高气扬的女人声音：“喂！”
言安希没抬头，直到看见一只涂着鲜艳的红色指甲油的手伸了过来，然后毫不客气的在她肩膀上戳了一下：“喂，叫你呢，没听见啊？”

Chapter 23 The way to make money is cut off (page 1)
"Oh..." Yan Anxi nodded, that was just right, otherwise she would have to eat at the same table with him, and she didn't know what to do.
Last night he slammed the door and walked away. I don't know if he has calmed down today.
The housekeeper said kindly: "The skirt my wife is wearing today fits you very well. It seems that the store clerk's size estimate is quite accurate. Madam, if it is convenient for you, please have someone come and measure you for the exact size."
Yan Anxi rolled her eyes. Are you going to customize clothes for her? That's good, she doesn't think it's too much. For her, one more thing... it's all money.
She pretended to be reserved and nodded, but her heart was filled with joy.
The housekeeper continued: "My wife's clothes are all customized. Mucheng only has this one, so it is better to have it according to your standard size..."
"What?" Before the butler finished speaking, Yan Anxi had already screamed, "Only one? Is it more limited edition than limited edition?"
"Yes, the brand has customized it exclusively for you. Look at the skirt today, it suits your temperament very well."
Yan Anxi's heart suddenly fell from heaven to rock bottom. She only had one piece of clothing, how could she resell it?
This good way to make money was just cut off.
Yan Anxi couldn't hide her disappointment at all, nodded to the housekeeper perfunctorily, and then went to eat breakfast by herself.
Hateful, hateful, did Mu Chi Yao do it on purpose? Had he already thought that she might resell the valuable things, so he had blocked her escape route?
After Yan Anxi finished her breakfast, Xia Chuchu sent her a text message: We will meet at the gate of Yuanhua Company at half past nine.
She stood up, picked up her bag and put it on her back. The housekeeper asked, "Madam, are you going out?"
"Okay, ma'am, please wait a moment, I'll arrange a car for you."
"No, no, no," Yan Anxi waved her hands quickly, "I can just go by myself, no need to bother."
She was looking for a job, not for inspection. Mu Chi Yao's car was worth a lot of money just driving out. If she went to apply for a job in a luxury car, which company would dare to hire her?
At Yan Anxi's insistence, the housekeeper had no choice but to compromise.
Yan Anxi walked out of the villa and walked out quickly.
It was morning now, the sun was shining brightly, and she could really see how luxurious this Nianhua Villa was.
She just glanced at it briefly last night, but now she looked carefully and was shocked again.
Yan Anxi sighed while looking around. When he walked to the large carved iron gate, he saw a white convertible sports car parked outside, with a woman wearing sunglasses sitting inside. Her red lips were very coquettish.
She didn't recognize him either, so she didn't pay attention and walked out from the small door next to her. This was when she truly walked out of Nianhua Villa.
Yan Anxi stood at the gate of Nianhua Villa, thinking about which way to go to the subway station or bus station. She was a road addict and had always had a poor sense of direction.
She was thinking about taking out her mobile phone to check the map when she suddenly heard a very arrogant woman's voice: "Hey!"
Yan Anxi didn't look up until she saw a hand with bright red nail polish reaching out, and then poked her shoulder unceremoniously: "Hey, I called you, didn't you hear me?"
